content: {"a_point": "When determining the start date of a new disability benefit entitlement under Art. 28 al. 1 let. b LAI, the one-year waiting period must be observed even if the lower court has remitted the case for reassessment of the invalidity income, as the waiting period is a statutory condition for entitlement.", "b_propositions": [{"a_id": "S32", "b_speaker": "court", "c_slot": "rule"}, {"a_id": "S33", "b_speaker": "court", "c_slot": "answer"}]}
